description: Public-safe package shades for the OpenClawd hackathon bundle.

packages.name: openclawd
packages.shade: Solana-native AI agent monorepo for payments, MCP tools, memory, wallet policy, and developer surfaces.
packages.hackathon_role: Shared architecture for autonomous robotics and trading loops.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/mcp
packages.shade: MCP boundary for Helius, Jupiter, wallet reads, token data, memory, and future robot tools.
packages.hackathon_role: Standardizes read-only observation, paper-trading tools, and gated execution.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/agents-registry
packages.shade: Agent registry and Metaplex-ready metadata catalog.
packages.hackathon_role: Makes robot and trader agents discoverable as Solana actors.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/leviathan
packages.shade: Sovereign lifecycle runtime for spawn, sense, think, strike, and drift.
packages.hackathon_role: Gives autonomous agents a repeatable lifecycle.

packages.name: llm-wiki-tang
packages.shade: AutoResearch wiki over Solana market and wallet data.
packages.hackathon_role: Stores research runs and feeds the self-evolving strategy loop.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/honcho-bridge
packages.hackathon_role: Persists operator preferences, strategy lineage, and durable agent self-models.

packages.name: plugin.delivery
packages.shade: Plugin marketplace, SDK, gateway, and attestation-aware manifests.
packages.hackathon_role: Lets agents discover paid specialist capabilities.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/clawdrouter
packages.shade: Wallet-signed LLM router with USDC micropayment support.

packages.name: services/attestation-agent
packages.shade: Solana Attestation Service schemas, credentials, attestations, and MPL Core birth flows.
packages.hackathon_role: Creates verifiable receipts for commands, plugins, identities, and strategy research.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/clawd-code-cli
packages.shade: AI terminal operator for coding, operations, and Solana workflows.
packages.hackathon_role: Developer cockpit for inspection and controlled execution.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/clawd-tui
packages.shade: Operator terminal UI with Solana-aware tools.
packages.hackathon_role: Human review surface for policy-gated autonomy.

packages.name: @openclawdsolana/gateway
packages.shade: Multi-channel trading agent control plane with robotics hardware and task-intent routes.
packages.hackathon_role: Connects chat surfaces, market data, robot targets, x402/MPP/Pay.sh intents, and agent lifecycle operations.

packages.name: openclawd-go
packages.shade: Stdlib-only Go binary for robot hardware installation and OpenClawd gateway calls.
packages.hackathon_role: Lets physical robot compute register with the gateway and request paid task envelopes without installing the Node workspace.

packages.name: Robotics
packages.shade: OCASV1 / OPENCLAWDASV1 hardware package with Asimov v1 CAD, wiring, motion-control device tree, MuJoCo model, NVIDIA Isaac GR00T integration, and public licenses.
packages.hackathon_role: Provides the real Solana robot target for the robotics submission.

packages.name: clawdhub
packages.shade: Public skills marketplace, agent registry, tracker, wallet, and console.
packages.hackathon_role: Discovery layer for agents, skills, and paid plugins.

packages.name: chrome-extension
packages.shade: Browser-side GUI vision agent, wallet adapter, and MCP bridge.
